title: Reducing False Positives in Strong-Lens Searches with Generalized-Mean Consensus of Machine-Learning Ensembles in the Kilo-Degree Survey
comment: 16 pages, 4 tables, 8 figures. Submitted to A&A
summary: Context. In wide-field surveys, the main challenge is not just classifier sensitivity, but the overwhelming number of false positives. Searching for strong lenses among millions to bilions of galaxies produces many contaminants, making the bottleneck for follow-up inspection and building statistically useful lens samples. Aims. We aim to improve the purity of strong-lens candidate selection in KiDS DR4 by combining several classifiers. The objective is to retain high completeness for known candidates while substantially reducing the fraction of non-lenses. Methods. We trained convolutional, Transformer-based, and hybrid classifiers, including Li ResNet+, Swin Transformer variants, Swin-MLP, and DemiLensNet. Their probabilistic outputs were combined at score level using averaging and a generalized mean consensus. The models were tested on simulated KiDS-like lens images and then evaluated on real KiDS DR4 lens candidates embedded in a non-lens sample. Results. On the simulated test set, ensembles show no advantage over the best single models. On the mixed real KiDS test set, the arithmetic mean reduces the false-positive rate at 90% completeness from 0.016-0.020 (the range spanned by the two best individual models) to 0.011 for the seven-model ensemble. The generalized mean reduces it further, to 0.007. Applied to the full LRG and BG samples at the same 90% completeness level, the generalized mean reduces returned candidates by roughly 50% for LRGs and 70% for BGs, relative to the best single model. After visual inspection, we obtain 170 new high-quality candidates (24 Class A and 146 Class B), together with 1706 Class C candidates. Conclusions. Our results demonstrate that the generalized mean consensus of an ML ensemble strategy provides a practical route to reducing the visual inspection workload while preserving a high recovery rate of promising strong-lens candidates.

title: Impact on time delays due to milli-lensing by subhalos on lensed gravitational waves
summary: Dark matter substructure properties such as their mass function and spatial distribution depend on the nature of dark matter and are strong tests of the cosmological model. Like luminous matter, these dark matter substructures cause gravitational lensing affecting observables such as time delays. Given the millisecond-level timing precision achievable with current and future gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, gravitationally lensed GWs provide a powerful probe of dark matter substructure, especially, at the lower end of the mass function. In contrast, the optical (or electromagnetic) observations can provide a precision of a few hours and are thus, not sensitive to deflections from the less massive subhalos. In this work, we investigate the impact of realistic population of DM subhalos ($10^6-10^9 M_\odot$) on the lensing time delays for two of the typical strong lens configurations, a fold and a cusp, seen in quadruply lensed sources for a galaxy-scale lens. We find that the subhalos with NFW density profiles cause perturbations of the order of few hours to the lensing time delays between the macro-lensed images produced by the main lensing galaxy. These time delay "anomalies", if not accounted for, may affect the results of strong lens searches conducted on the GW data by the LIGO--Virgo--Kagra collaboration. Lastly, for the 200 realisations analysed per fold and cusp lens systems, we find that the NFW subhalos produced no additional images of their own called milli-images. Statistical studies are needed to better determine the expected impact on the lensed GW time delays and (non-)detection of milli-images.

AI.tldr: 本文研究暗物质子晕对强引力透镜时间延迟的影响，发现NFW子晕可产生数小时量级的时间延迟异常。
AI.motivation: 暗物质子结构的质量函数和空间分布依赖于暗物质本质，是检验宇宙学模型的强有力手段。引力波探测器具备毫秒级时间精度，可通过引力透镜效应对暗物质子结构进行探测，而光学观测精度仅为数小时，无法感知低质量子晕的偏折效应。
AI.method: 针对星系尺度透镜的四重透镜源，选取折叠（fold）和尖点（cusp）两种典型强透镜构型，引入质量范围为10^6-10^9太阳质量的真实暗物质子晕种群，考察其对宏透镜图像间引力透镜时间延迟的影响，并对每种构型进行200次实现。
AI.result: 具有NFW密度剖面的子晕对主透镜星系产生的宏透镜图像之间的时间延迟造成数小时量级的扰动；在每种折叠和尖点透镜系统的200次实现中，NFW子晕未产生自身的额外图像（即毫图像）。
AI.conclusion: 这些时间延迟"异常"若未被考虑，可能影响LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组基于引力波数据开展的强透镜搜寻结果；需要进一步统计研究以更好地确定其对透镜引力波时间延迟及毫图像（非）探测的影响。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 暗物质子结构的性质，如其质量函数和空间分布，取决于暗物质的本质，并且是对宇宙学模型的强有力检验。与发光物质类似，这些暗物质子结构会引起引力透镜效应，从而影响诸如时间延迟等可观测量。鉴于当前和未来引力波（GW）探测器可达到的毫秒级计时精度，引力透镜化的GW为探测暗物质子结构提供了强有力的手段，尤其是在质量函数的下限。相比之下，光学（或电磁）观测只能提供几小时的精度，因此对来自较轻子晕的偏折不敏感。在本工作中，我们研究了暗物质子晕（$10^6-10^9 M_\odot$）的真实群体对两种典型强透镜构型（折叠和尖点）在星系尺度透镜的四重透镜源中所产生的透镜时间延迟的影响。我们发现，具有NFW密度剖面的子晕会对由主透镜星系产生的宏观透镜图像之间的透镜时间延迟造成几小时量级的扰动。这些时间延迟“异常”若未被考虑，可能会影响LIGO--Virgo--Kagra合作组基于GW数据进行的强透镜搜寻结果。最后，对于每个折叠和尖点透镜系统分析的200个实现，我们发现NFW子晕没有产生它们自身的额外图像，称为毫图像。需要统计研究来更好地确定对透镜GW时间延迟的预期影响以及毫图像的（非）探测。

title: LATED: JWST integral field spectroscopy of a galaxy caught in chemical infancy at $z=4.8$ behind Abell 2744
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables; comments are welcome
summary: When Population III (Pop III) star formation ended remains an open question. LATED-1 is an intrinsically faint ($M_\mathrm{UV}=-16.15$) Ly$α$ emitter at $z=4.80$ revealed by VLT/MUSE behind the lensing cluster Abell 2744 ($z=0.308$). Before any spectroscopic metallicity constraints, it was identified as an extremely metal-poor or metal-free galaxy candidate from JWST imaging by LATED, our novel photometric selection framework. Here we present serendipitous JWST/NIRSpec PRISM integral-field spectroscopy of this target. title: Feeding the Void: Co-evolution of the SIDM-seeded Black Hole and the dark halo after core-collapse
summary: While the gravothermal collapse of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) halos provides a compelling mechanism for seeding supermassive black holes (BHs), the post-collapse macroscopic co-evolution of the BH and its host halo remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce a novel N-body framework to dynamically model the dark matter accretion onto the central BH. By bracketing the accretion rate with two complementary phenomenological schemes---a `multi-round core-collapse' scenario and a `continuous accretion' scenario---we establish bounds on the BH mass growth trajectory. We find that the BH mass reaches $5\%-12\%$ of the total halo mass within $\lesssim2$ Gyr post-collapse. Concurrently, this sustained mass depletion drives a `gravothermal supply chain' that forces outer dark matter inward, severely depleting the inner halo density ($\lesssim 2r_s$). This unique structural imprint qualitatively matches the recently detected anomaly in the strong lens JVAS B1938+666 (detection V), where the best-fit lens model consists of an unresolved central point mass and a shallow, uniform-surface-density extended disk, offering a distinct observational signature for SIDM-seeded BHs.

title: JWST Observations of Starbursts: The motion of dust - PAH kinematics of M82 and NGC 253 with JWST/MIRI spectroscopy
comment: 19 pages, 13 figures, Accepted for publication in ApJ
summary: We present an analysis of dust kinematics in the local starburst galaxies M82 (NGC 3034) and NGC 253 using Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbon (PAH) features observed with JWST/MIRI spectroscopy. We are able to produce high-quality velocity maps of the 5.2 $μ$m, 6.2 $μ$m, and 11.3 $μ$m PAH features, as well as numerous lines of molecular gas via H$_2$ rotational transitions and ionized gas from [NeII] and H recombination lines. Given the field of view and inclination, we trace a rotating disk in M82 where we observe a steep rise in the velocities followed by flattening, typical of galaxy rotation curves. In NGC 253, however, the 6.2 $μ$m and 11.3 $μ$m PAH features trace the launching region of the outflow, firmly within the starburst region. We find the ionized gas also shows outflow contributions in NGC 253 while the warm molecular gas is dominated by rotation. Additionally, the molecular gas outflow velocities are lower than the ionized gas, with the 11.3 $μ$m PAH feature consistent with the ionized gas rather than the molecular gas. We therefore suggest that PAHs are more closely associated with the ionized gas rather than the molecular at the base of the galaxy outflow, where larger scale imaging shows comparable morphology between PAHs and HI. The 6.2 $μ$m PAH feature has an even higher outflow velocity for both galaxies, possibly suggesting preferential ionization of the PAHs within the faster-moving hot phase of the base of the outflow.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们利用JWST/MIRI光谱观测到的多环芳烃（PAH）特征，对近邻星暴星系M82（NGC 3034）和NGC 253中的尘埃运动学进行了分析。我们能够生成5.2 $\mu$m、6.2 $\mu$m和11.3 $\mu$m PAH特征的高质量速度图，以及通过H$_2$转动跃迁得到的多条分子气体谱线和来自[NeII]及H复合线的电离气体谱线。考虑到视场和倾角，我们在M82中追踪到一个旋转盘，其中速度先急剧上升然后趋于平缓，这是典型的星系旋转曲线。然而在NGC 253中，6.2 $\mu$m和11.3 $\mu$m PAH特征追踪的是外流的发射区域，完全位于星暴区域内。我们发现NGC 253中的电离气体也显示出外流贡献，而暖分子气体则以旋转为主。此外，分子气体外流速度低于电离气体，11.3 $\mu$m PAH特征与电离气体一致而非分子气体。因此我们认为，在星系外流基部，PAH与电离气体的关联比与分子气体更紧密，更大尺度的成像显示PAH与HI的形态相当。两个星系的6.2 $\mu$m PAH特征都具有更高的外流速度，这可能表明PAH在外流基部快速运动的热相中优先电离。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：PAH在星系外流基部更紧密关联电离气体而非分子气体，可能与HI形态相当；6.2微米PAH更高外流速度暗示其优先在快速运动热相中电离。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Three-color NIRCAM images of M82 and NGC 253 using the F140M, F212N and F335M filters for blue, green and red respectively. The field of view of Channel 3 of the MIRI MRS observations are shown with the white box. The lower panels show a zoom of the central regions. Note that there is some saturation of the images for NGC 253 from the cluster region that we mask as discussed in Section III.1 .
figures.caption_zh: 图1：M82和NGC 253的三色NIRCAM图像，分别使用F140M、F212N和F335M滤光片作为蓝、绿和红色。MIRI MRS观测的通道3视场用白色方框显示。下方面板显示了中心区域的放大图。注意NGC 253的图像在星团区域存在一些饱和，我们在第III.1节中对此进行了掩模处理。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Velocity maps of various emission features in M82. We show maps of various PAH features, rotational transitions of H 2 , and ionized gas via [Ne II], [Ne III] and the hydrogen recombination line Pf \(\alpha\) . The position angle of the major axis of the galaxy disk is shown with the gray dashed lines, while the outflow direction, which is perpendicular to the disk, is shown in the dotted line. We mask spaxels with a velocity error \(>100\) km s -1 . Note the presence of the outflow in the 6.2 \(\mu\) m and 11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH velocity maps.
figures.caption_zh: 图2：M82中各种发射特征的速度图。我们展示了各种PAH特征、H 2 的转动跃迁以及通过[Ne II]、[Ne III]和氢复合线Pf \(\alpha\) 的电离气体的图。星系盘长轴的位置角用灰色虚线表示，而垂直于盘的外流方向用点线表示。我们掩模了速度误差 \(>100\) km s -1 的spaxel。注意在6.2 \(\mu\) m和11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH速度图中存在外流。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: The same as Fig. 2 but for NGC 253. Here we see velocities of the 6.2 \(\mu\) m and 11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH features along the outflow axis compared to the other lines which have a stronger disk contribution to the velocity maps.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：与图2相同，但针对NGC 253。这里我们看到沿外流轴的6.2 \(\mu\) m和11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH特征的速度，与其他在速度图中具有更强盘贡献的谱线相比。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: 1D velocity profiles of the disk and outflow axes. Top panels show the velocity profiles extracted through 2 ′′ wide apertures along the major axis of the disk for M82 and NGC 253 with various emission features. The bottom panels show the velocity profiles through 1 ′′ wide apertures of the outflow, taken perpendicular to the major axis of the disk. The PAH features are shown with a solid line, the H 2 lines are shown with a dashed line while the ionized gas tracers are shown with a dotted line. The shaded regions show the 1 \(\sigma\) errors in the velocity. We omit the 5.2 \(\mu\) m and 16.4 \(\mu\) m PAH features from this plot as there may be non-negligible contributions to the inferred velocity from variations in the intrinsic profile as demonstrated in Fig. 11 . We also omit the 6.2 \(\mu\) m and 11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH features for the disk profiles of NGC 253 as these features are dominated by the outflow. It is worth noting that these are only statistical errors from the Monte Carlo repeats of the PCA process and do not account for calibration uncertainties and therefore should be taken as lower limits of the errors. In the bottom panels the vertical lines show the position of the nucleus labeled “Original” and the adjusted center position labeled “Recentered” to coincide with where the sign of the velocity flips.
figures.caption_zh: 图4：盘和外流轴的一维速度剖面。顶部面板显示了通过沿盘长轴的2 ′′ 宽孔径提取的M82和NGC 253的各种发射特征的速度剖面。底部面板显示了通过垂直于盘长轴的1 ′′ 宽孔径提取的外流速度剖面。PAH特征用实线表示，H 2 线用虚线表示，而电离气体示踪剂用点线表示。阴影区域显示了速度的1 \(\sigma\) 误差。我们从该图中省略了5.2 \(\mu\) m和16.4 \(\mu\) m PAH特征，因为如图11所示，固有剖面的变化可能对推断的速度有不可忽略的贡献。我们还省略了NGC 253盘剖面的6.2 \(\mu\) m和11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH特征，因为这些特征由外流主导。值得注意的是，这些只是来自PCA过程蒙特卡洛重复的统计误差，并未考虑校准不确定性，因此应被视为误差的下限。在底部面板中，垂直线显示了标记为“Original”的核位置和标记为“Recentered”的调整后中心位置，以与速度符号翻转的位置重合。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Profiles of the 6.2 \(\mu\) m and 11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH features at the peak velocities (red and blue) along the outflow axis of NGC 253 (see Fig. 4 ) compared to the rest frame profile. The residual panels show the difference between each profile and the rest frame profile. Note that the profiles have been normalized to their peaks for visualization. The absorption feature at \(\sim 5.18\mu\) m is likely the 110-101 ro-vibrational transition of H 2 O, which is particularity strong in the nucleus giving rise to the spikes in the \(\Delta f_{\nu}\) panel. This figure demonstrates how subtle the shifts in the profile are compared to its width and thus techniques such as PCA tomography are necessary to extract the velocity information from the data cube.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：沿NGC 253外流轴（见图4）在峰值速度（红色和蓝色）处的6.2 \(\mu\) m和11.3 \(\mu\) m PAH特征的剖面与静止帧剖面的比较。残差面板显示了每个剖面与静止帧剖面之间的差异。注意，为了可视化，剖面已归一化到其峰值。在 \(\sim 5.18\mu\) m处的吸收特征可能是H 2 O的110-101振转跃迁，它在核中特别强，导致 \(\Delta f_{\nu}\) 面板中出现尖峰。该图表明，与剖面宽度相比，剖面的偏移是多么微妙，因此需要PCA层析成像等技术来从数据立方体中提取速度信息。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Outflow scenario consistent with our observations. Within the \(\sim\) 50 pc region at the base of the outflow, molecular clouds are accelerated slowly while the outer layers of ionized gas and PAHs mix with the fast hot ionized wind, resulting in higher velocities of HI and PAHs compared to H 2 . Additionally, the most mixed PAHs may be preferentially ionized, leading to higher velocities of the 6.2 \(\mu\) m PAH feature.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：与我们的观测一致的外流情景。在 \(\sim\) 50 pc的外流基部区域内，分子云被缓慢加速，而电离气体和PAH的外层与快速热电离风混合，导致HI和PAH的速度高于H 2 。此外，混合最多的PAH可能优先电离，导致6.2 \(\mu\) m PAH特征的速度更高。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Comparison of the velocity maps inferred using the traditional method of fitting a Gaussian to every spaxel compared to the PCA technique. We show the [Ne II] and H 2 S(5) lines for M82. This test demonstrates the robustness of PCA tomography to measure velocities. The median difference in velocity between the two maps is \(|\Delta v|\lesssim 3\) km s -1 .
figures.caption_zh: 图7：使用传统方法（对每个spaxel拟合高斯）与PCA技术推断的速度图的比较。我们展示了M82的[Ne II]和H 2 S(5)线。该测试证明了PCA层析成像测量速度的稳健性。两个图之间的速度中值差异为 \(|\Delta v|\lesssim 3\) km s -1 。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: The first and second principal components of the PAH features for M82. The first two columns show the first component, with the left panels showing the tomograms while the right panels show the corresponding eigenspectrum (orange). The second component is shown in the final two columns, where the dashed blue line shows the derivative of the first principal component eigenspectrum, which should match the second principal component in the case of a Doppler shift. This plot demonstrates that velocity shifts dominate the profile changes rather than variations in the intrinsic profile.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：M82的PAH特征的第一和第二主成分。前两列显示了第一成分，左侧面板显示层析图，右侧面板显示相应的特征谱（橙色）。第二成分显示在最后两列中，其中蓝色虚线显示了第一主成分特征谱的导数，在多普勒频移的情况下，它应与第二主成分匹配。该图表明，速度偏移主导了剖面变化，而不是固有剖面的变化。

title: Probing modified gravity with galaxy-cluster-lensed gravitational-wave time delays: impact of systematic effects
summary: Strongly lensed gravitational waves provide exceptionally precise measurements of relative macroimage arrival times, making their time delays a promising time-domain probe of gravity on galaxy-cluster scales. This precision places stringent demands on the control of lensing systematic effects. We present a proof-of-concept pipeline for constraining a phenomenological modification, $D$, of the galaxy cluster Weyl potential using the macroimage time-delay span of a simulated sample of binary neutron star (BNS) sources and cluster lenses described by a Navarro--Frenk--White cluster halo and a singular isothermal sphere for the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG). Closure tests recover the injected general-relativistic (GR) limit. Adopting a fiducial 5 per cent precision on the reconstructed time-delay span, we assess controlled mis-specifications of the halo mass and concentration, BCG contribution, source and lens positions, redshifts, line-of-sight environment, projected ellipticity and secondary cluster-scale structure. Within the adopted gravity model, neglecting halo ellipticity, secondary cluster-scale structure, cluster mis-centring and line-of-sight perturbations can induce significant, strongly configuration-dependent biases in the inferred parameter $D$. Biased estimates of the cluster halo mass and concentration, as well as systematic BNS source-position errors at the level considered here, produce significant coherent shifts. By contrast, uncertainties in the BCG contribution and in the lens and source redshifts are comparatively subdominant. These results highlight the need for explicit treatment of the above uncertainties before cluster-lensed gravitational wave time delays can be used as precision tests of gravity.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 强透镜引力波提供了相对宏观像到达时间的极高精度测量，使其时间延迟成为在星系团尺度上探测引力的有前景的时域探针。这种精度对透镜系统效应的控制提出了严格要求。我们提出了一套概念验证流程，利用模拟的双中子星（BNS）源样本和由Navarro--Frenk--White星系团晕及最亮星系团星系（BCG）的奇异等温球描述的星系团透镜的宏观像时间延迟跨度，来约束星系团Weyl势的现象学修正 $D$。闭合测试恢复了注入的广义相对论（GR）极限。在重建的时间延迟跨度采用5%的基准精度下，我们评估了对晕质量和浓度、BCG贡献、源和透镜位置、红移、视线环境、投影椭率和次级星系团尺度结构的受控错误设定。在所采用的引力模型内，忽略晕椭率、次级星系团尺度结构、星系团偏心定位和视线扰动，可能在推断参数 $D$ 中引起显著的、强烈依赖于构型的偏差。对星系团晕质量和浓度的有偏估计，以及此处考虑水平上的系统性BNS源位置误差，会产生显著的一致偏移。相比之下，BCG贡献以及透镜和源红移的不确定性相对次要。这些结果凸显了在将星系团透镜引力波时间延迟用作精密引力检验之前，必须显式处理上述不确定性的必要性。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 在将星系团透镜引力波时延用作精密引力检验之前，必须显式处理上述不确定性。

title: The molecular gas of four ram pressure stripped galaxies in the core of the Hydra I cluster
summary: We present new CO(1-0) measurements from ALMA and new HI measurements from MeerKAT in four ram pressure stripped (RPS) galaxies in the core of the Hydra I cluster: NGC 3312, NGC 3314a, NGC 3314b and LEDA 753342. These deep data, with compatible spatial resolution in CO and HI ($\sim15''$, $\sim$4 kpc), help increase the low statistics of galaxies observed in CO at extreme infall stage for probing how molecular and atomic gas behave under high ICM pressures. We studied the cold gas morphologies of these galaxies, and found asymmetries in their detected CO disks with respect to their HI and optical disks. No stripped CO was found in the tails, which could support the scenario that H$_2$ displays morphological and velocity asymmetries in the disks before being stripped. We then compared the H$_{2}$/HI ratios and H$_{2}$ vs. HI deficiencies between the four Hydra I galaxies, the xCOLDGASS sample dominated by field galaxies and VIVA-VERTICO Virgo RPS galaxies. LEDA 753342 ($\rm log~M_{\star}/M_{\odot} = 8.6$) is below the stellar mass limit of the reference samples ($\rm log~M_{\star}/M_{\odot} = 9$), but its $\rm M_{H_2}/M_{HI}$ and cold gas deficiencies are compatible with lower stellar mass field and Virgo cluster galaxies. NGC 3312 and NGC 3314a are in an intermediate stage between field galaxies and more advanced RPS Virgo galaxies. NGC 3314b is more consistent with Virgo galaxies more advanced in RPS, than with field galaxies. We reason that LEDA 753342 is at a very early stage of RPS, that NGC 3314a and NGC 3312 are at a similar timescale of early but very active RPS with differences potentially due to unequal initial total baryonic mass and infall angles, and that NGC 3314b is the latest stage in RPS in the sample. These galaxies display RPS across different evolutionary stages, and suggest that RPS starts affecting the CO reservoir before it starts being stripped from the galaxy.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们展示了在长蛇座I星系团核心的四个受冲压剥离（RPS）星系：NGC 3312、NGC 3314a、NGC 3314b和LEDA 753342中，来自ALMA的新CO(1-0)测量和来自MeerKAT的新HI测量。这些深度数据在CO和HI中具有兼容的空间分辨率（$\sim15''$，$\sim$4 kpc），有助于增加在极端坠入阶段观测到的CO星系低统计量，以探究分子气体和原子气体在高ICM压力下的行为。我们研究了这些星系的冷气体形态，并发现其探测到的CO盘相对于HI和光学盘存在不对称性。在尾中未发现被剥离的CO，这可能支持H$_2$在被剥离之前在盘中显示出形态和速度不对称性的情景。然后，我们比较了四个长蛇座I星系、以场星系为主的xCOLDGASS样本和VIVA-VERTICO室女座RPS星系之间的H$_{2}$/HI比率以及H$_{2}$与HI的缺陷。LEDA 753342（$\rm log~M_{\star}/M_{\odot} = 8.6$）低于参考样本的恒星质量极限（$\rm log~M_{\star}/M_{\odot} = 9$），但其$\rm M_{H_2}/M_{HI}$和冷气体缺陷与较低恒星质量的场星系和室女座星系团星系相容。NGC 3312和NGC 3314a处于场星系与更高级RPS室女座星系之间的中间阶段。NGC 3314b与RPS更高级的室女座星系比与场星系更一致。我们推断LEDA 753342处于RPS的极早期阶段，NGC 3314a和NGC 3312处于早期但非常活跃的RPS的相似时间尺度，差异可能由于初始总重子质量和坠入角不同，而NGC 3314b是样本中RPS的最晚阶段。这些星系展示了不同演化阶段的RPS，并表明RPS在CO储库开始从星系中被剥离之前就已开始影响它。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：LEDA 753342处于RPS极早期，NGC 3314a与NGC 3312处于早期但活跃的RPS阶段，NGC 3314b为样本中最晚期阶段；RPS在气体被剥离出星系之前就已开始影响CO储库。

title: SALVAGE II: no systematic molecular gas depletion in the central 2 kpc of AGN hosts
summary: In cosmological simulations, active galactic nuclei (AGN) feedback is found to be necessary for the shutdown of galaxy-wide star-formation by heating and/or removing molecular gas. However, at low-redshift, there is little evidence of systematic large-scale gas depletion. Some recent observations have found molecular gas depletion in AGN hosts, but limited to the central regions of galaxies. In this work, we use the SDSS-ALMA Legacy-Value Archival Gas Exploration (SALVAGE) dataset, which provides molecular gas and stellar mass measurements from the inner (r < 0.5-2 kpc) and outer region of the galaxy. Using AGN diagnostics from optical emission lines, mid-IR colour, and X-ray luminosity, we identify 70 AGN at z < 0.07 and inspect their central molecular gas reservoirs with a suite of metrics compared to non-AGN controls. In agreement with global studies of low-z AGN hosts, we find that, compared to matched non-AGN, the central regions of AGN have equal molecular gas fractions and enhanced molecular gas surface densities. For the first time, we explore the central gas reservoirs of AGN identified with different selection criteria and find two optical AGN classes that show a tentative 1.5$σ$ and 1.8$σ$ signal of central molecular gas depletion. However, the AGN with central gas depletion do not occupy any specific region of the parameter space, such as AGN luminosity, that can provide a physical explanation for the depletion. If AGN are responsible for large-scale gas removal, the lack of systematic gas depletion in SALVAGE AGN sets an upper limit on the physical scale of the gas removal while the AGN remains observable.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在宇宙学模拟中，活动星系核（AGN）反馈被认为是通过加热和/或移除分子气体来关闭星系尺度恒星形成所必需的。然而，在低红移下，几乎没有证据表明存在系统性的大规模气体耗竭。最近的一些观测发现AGN宿主星系中存在分子气体耗竭，但仅限于星系的中心区域。在这项工作中，我们使用SDSS-ALMA Legacy-Value Archival Gas Exploration（SALVAGE）数据集，该数据集提供了星系内部（r < 0.5-2 kpc）和外部区域的分子气体和恒星质量测量。利用来自光学发射线、中红外颜色和X射线光度的AGN诊断，我们在z < 0.07处识别出70个AGN，并使用一系列指标与非AGN对照样本比较，检查其中心分子气体储备。与低红移AGN宿主星系的全局研究一致，我们发现，与匹配的非AGN相比，AGN的中心区域具有相同的分子气体分数和增强的分子气体表面密度。我们首次探索了通过不同选择标准识别的AGN的中心气体储备，并发现两个光学AGN类别显示出初步的1.5$\sigma$和1.8$\sigma$的中心分子气体耗竭信号。然而，具有中心气体耗竭的AGN并不占据参数空间中的任何特定区域，例如AGN光度，这可以为耗竭提供物理解释。如果AGN负责大规模气体清除，那么SALVAGE AGN中缺乏系统性气体耗竭为气体清除的物理尺度设定了上限，同时AGN仍可被观测到。

title: Mid-Infrared Diagnostics of PAH Processing and Radiation Fields in M33 H II Regions with JWST/MIRI
comment: 25 page, 15 figures, Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal (ApJ)
summary: We present JWST/MIRI (Proposal ID 4297) medium-resolution integral field spectroscopy of five H II regions in the nearby spiral galaxy M33, obtained from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST). The fully calibrated Level-3 spectral cubes provide continuous wavelength coverage from 6.5 - 20.9~$μ$m, enabling analysis of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) emission, ionic fine-structure lines, and warm molecular hydrogen. The spectra show prominent PAH bands at 7.7, 8.6, and 11.3~$μ$m, multiple H$_2$ rotational transitions, and hydrogen recombination lines. H$_2$ rotational diagrams yield warm molecular gas temperatures of $\sim316$ - $407$~K. The detected [Ne II], [Ne III], [S III], and [S IV] lines yield ionization indices of $-1.41$ to $+0.98$. The PAH ionization fraction shows no clear dependence on radiation hardness, consistent with previous Spitzer results. Unlike previous work, we find no clear correlation between the 7.7/11.2 and 8.6/11.2~$μ$m PAH ratios, while the 7.7/11.2~$μ$m ratio shows a moderate negative correlation with metallicity, possibly due to our small sample ($N=5$). The PAH-to-VSG ratio decreases with increasing radiation hardness. We derive the ionization parameter $γ$, far-ultraviolet radiation field, and PAH charge state, finding a predominantly cationic PAH population ($\sim75%$) despite [Ne III]/[Ne II] $<1$. The lack of a one-to-one correspondence between $γ$ and the 7.7/11.2~$μ$m ratio suggests that PAH ionization is influenced by additional environmental factors. Given the limited sample, these trends are suggestive rather than statistically definitive.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们展示了JWST/MIRI（提案编号4297）对邻近螺旋星系M33中五个H II区的中等分辨率积分场光谱观测，数据获取自Mikulski太空望远镜档案（MAST）。完全校准的Level-3光谱立方体提供了6.5 - 20.9~$μ$m的连续波长覆盖，使得能够分析多环芳烃（PAH）发射、离子精细结构线和暖分子氢。光谱显示出显著的PAH谱带位于7.7、8.6和11.3~$μ$m，多个H$_2$转动跃迁以及氢复合线。H$_2$转动图给出暖分子气体温度为$\sim316$ - $407$~K。探测到的[Ne II]、[Ne III]、[S III]和[S IV]线给出的电离指数为$-1.41$至$+0.98$。PAH电离分数未显示出与辐射硬度的明显依赖关系，与先前Spitzer结果一致。与先前工作不同，我们发现7.7/11.2和8.6/11.2~$μ$m PAH比值之间没有明显相关性，而7.7/11.2~$μ$m比值与金属丰度呈中等负相关，可能由于我们的样本较小（$N=5$）。PAH与VSG的比值随辐射硬度增加而降低。我们推导了电离参数$γ$、远紫外辐射场和PAH电荷态，发现尽管[Ne III]/[Ne II] $<1$，PAH群体主要为阳离子（$\sim75%$）。$γ$与7.7/11.2~$μ$m比值之间缺乏一一对应关系表明PAH电离受额外环境因素影响。鉴于样本有限，这些趋势仅为提示性而非统计确定性。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：γ与7.7/11.2 μm比之间缺乏一一对应，表明PAH电离受额外环境因素影响；受样本量限制，上述趋势仅为提示性而非统计确定性。

title: The magnetic field in the multi-phase interstellar medium of NGC 6946
comment: 26 pages, 14 figures; accepted for publication in ApJ
summary: Magnetic fields regulate the multi-phase interstellar medium (ISM) of spiral galaxies, yet their behavior across ISM phases remains poorly constrained observationally. We present a comparative polarimetric study of the nearby spiral galaxy NGC 6946 using far-infrared (FIR) data at 154 $μ$m from SOFIA/HAWC+ and radio continuum data at 6 cm from the VLA and Effelsberg telescopes, which probe magnetic fields in the cold dust-emitting and diffuse synchrotron-emitting phases of the ISM, respectively. The synchrotron polarization reveals a coherent large-scale spiral magnetic field, with high polarization fractions in interarm regions and strong depolarization in star-forming arms. The FIR polarization fraction is lower on average and shows stronger spatial variations. Both tracers decrease systematically with increasing star formation activity, indicating that star-formation-driven turbulence reduces magnetic field ordering; the synchrotron polarization fraction is strongly suppressed in the central kiloparsec but stable across the mid disk, with a tendency to increase beyond $R \approx 7$ kpc, while the FIR polarization fraction remains low ($\sim$2-3%) and approximately constant over the radial range where it can be reliably measured ($R \lesssim 5.4$ kpc). Our results indicate that NGC 6946 hosts a globally ordered magnetic field locally modulated by turbulence. This study highlights the complementary nature of FIR and radio polarimetry in probing magnetic fields across ISM phases and provides quantitative constraints on how magnetic field ordering varies between the cold and diffuse ISM components.

AI.tldr: 结合SOFIA/HAWC+ 154 μm远红外与VLA/Effelsberg 6 cm射电偏振数据，对NGC 6946中冷尘埃相与弥散同步辐射相的磁场进行对比研究，发现其具有全局有序、局部被湍流调制的磁场结构。
AI.motivation: 磁场调控旋涡星系的多相星际介质（ISM），但其在不同ISM相中的行为在观测上仍缺乏约束，需要借助多波段偏振手段进行对比研究。
AI.method: 使用SOFIA/HAWC+的154 μm远红外偏振数据（探测冷尘埃发射相磁场）与VLA和Effelsberg的6 cm射电连续谱偏振数据（探测弥散同步辐射相磁场），对近邻旋涡星系NGC 6946开展比较偏振测量，并分析偏振分数与恒星形成活动及径向距离的关系。
AI.result: 同步辐射偏振显示出相干的大尺度旋涡磁场，在臂间区偏振分数高、在恒星形成旋臂中强烈退偏振；远红外偏振分数平均更低且空间变化更强。两种示踪量的偏振分数均随恒星形成活动增强而系统性下降。同步辐射偏振分数在中心千秒差距被强烈压制但在中盘稳定，并在R≈7 kpc之外有上升趋势；远红外偏振分数在可可靠测量的径向范围（R≲5.4 kpc）内保持约2–3%的低值且大致恒定。
AI.conclusion: NGC 6946拥有全局有序但被湍流局部调制的磁场；该研究凸显了远红外与射电偏振在探测不同ISM相磁场方面的互补性，并为磁场有序度在冷相与弥散相之间的差异提供了定量约束。

figures.caption_zh: 图6：NGC 6946中6 cm（蓝色）和154 \(\mu\) m（红色）偏振强度（PI）分布的核密度估计（KDE）。x轴显示\(\log_{10}({PI})\)，单位为\({Jy\ arcsec^{-2}}\)，突出显示射电分布比FIR分布更窄。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7 : Pixel-by-pixel comparison of the polarization and intensity properties at 154 \(\mu\) m and 6 cm in NGC 6946. The left panel shows the relation between the polarization fractions at 154 \(\mu\) m and 6 cm, the right panel presents the comparison between the polarized intensities at 154 \(\mu\) m (dust emission) and 6 cm (synchrotron emission), and the bottom panel shows the correlation between the total 6 cm radio continuum surface brightness, \(I_{6\,{cm}}\) , and the 154 \(\mu\) m far-infrared surface brightness, \(I_{154\,\mu{m}}\) . Gray triangles correspond to spiral-arm regions, while green squares denote the central region. Solid lines indicate the best-fit relations where applicable.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：NGC 6946中154 \(\mu\) m和6 cm处偏振和强度特性的逐像素比较。左面板显示154 \(\mu\) m和6 cm处偏振度之间的关系，右面板展示154 \(\mu\) m（尘埃发射）和6 cm（同步辐射发射）处偏振强度之间的比较，底部面板显示6 cm射电连续谱表面亮度\(I_{6\,{cm}}\)与154 \(\mu\) m远红外表面亮度\(I_{154\,\mu{m}}\)之间的相关性。灰色三角形对应旋臂区域，而绿色方块表示中心区域。实线表示适用时的最佳拟合关系。
